incident-bot: :rotating_light: SLO alarm: streaming endpoint /v1/chat/stream degraded (hosted). p95=1.9s, p99=5.9s, error-rate 1.1% over 10m. Preproc queue backlog rising. Runbook PREPROC_HIGH_LATENCY auto-invoked.
Ana (oncall): Acknowledged. pulling logs and start timeline. Who's on the preproc stack?
Zayd (infra): Preproc host pool showing CPU saturation on preproc-nodes 3 and 4. HPA didn't scale because controller-manager backoff. kube events show leader-election delay for the controller.
Marta (runtime): Noticed streaming stalls: clients report partial chunks then silence. Tokenization spikes on certain requests. Suspect recent json-mode template change.
Raj (ml): Pulse check: aggregated tokenization times (1h): p50 40ms, p95 380ms, p99 2.0s. High tail aligns with requests embedding large tool schemas.
Sophia (support): Customer Emily DM'd example payloads. Emily, are you on a support call?
Emily (customer): yes, live. We're using json_mode with a big tool schema. client hits stream timeout ~30s. This is impacting our users.
Ana (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) divert affected traffic to a lighter model variant (disable json-mode path) 2) scale preproc to 6 replicas 3) temporarily rate-limit very large templates (>50k chars). Applying step 1 now.
deploy-bot: Route override applied: POST /ops/route/override -> ok (rollout r-2026-07-15-3).
Ana (oncall): Scaling preproc now:
```
kubectl scale deploy/preproc -n inference --replicas=6
kubectl get pods -l app=preproc -n inference
```
Zayd (infra): Scaling underway. New pods coming up (4 -> 6). Also restarting controller-manager on infra-3 to clear the autoscaler backoff.
Marta (runtime): I added a temporary routing rule: if request has "json_mode":true and template_size > 2048, route to model-lite-v2. Avoids heavy expansion path.
Raj (ml): Correlation: json_mode=true requests have median tokenization ~12x normal. Expansion step concatenates schema into template and triggers tokenize on large strings. Complexity is blowing up for nested tool schemas.
Sophia (support): Customer update: they can accept degraded responses if streams resume. Asking for ETA.
Emily (customer): need an ETA for stable streaming please.
Ana (oncall): ETA 10-15m after routes and scale. If p99 still high we'll disable json-mode at the gateway.
Marta (runtime): Early improvements visible: p95 dropped to ~1.2s, p99 ~3.6s since the route change. Queue depth reduced by ~50%.
Raj (ml): Repro snippet I captured: prompt template does eager expansion of a 15k tool schema, then passes whole string to tokenize. Path: render_template -> expand_schema -> stringify -> tokenize_string (no streaming).
Ana (oncall): Root cause candidate: PR #4921 introduced eager tool-schema expansion in json-mode for structured output preservation. That causes huge string materialization before tokenize.
Zayd (infra): Controller-manager restart completed. HPA back to normal. Filing INF-7342 to track the backoff bug.
Marta (runtime): Hotfix: short-circuit full stringify for json_mode when streaming=true; implement streaming-tokenize for schema segments. I'll push a canary.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: canary c-2026-07-15-12 for preproc.
Ana (oncall): Also adding gateway guard: reject requests with template_size > 60k chars with 413 and diagnostic message. This is a temporary protection.
Raj (ml): Long-term fixes: 1) streaming tokenization for expanded schemas 2) avoid O(n^2) concatenation in template compiler 3) add perf tests for large schemas and streaming codepath.
Sophia (support): I'll send customer status: mitigated via routing fallback; engineering is working on a patch; ETA ~2h for full remediation.
Emily (customer): thanks. please share updates.
Marta (runtime): Canary metrics look good: tokenization p99 down to 470ms vs 2.0s previously. Rolling hotfix to prod.
deploy-bot: Rollout started: r-2026-07-15-4, strategy 25% -> 60% -> 100%.
Ana (oncall): Monitoring: last 5m p95=0.85s, p99=1.5s, error-rate 0.25%. Streaming-stall counts down ~90% from peak.
Zayd (infra): Autoscaler healthy now. Opened INF-7342 for the backoff investigation.
Raj (ml): Open RT-8811 to implement streaming tokenizer and revert eager expansion; include benchmarks and tests.
Marta (runtime): Postmortem sketch: regression from json-mode expansion change, exacerbated by large tool schemas and streaming path. Mitigations: fallback routing, scale up, canary hotfix, gateway size cap.
Ana (oncall): Customer impact: subset of hosted customers using JSON-mode with large tool schemas experienced partial streaming stalls; about 3 customers had timeouts. Support offered temporary routing and credits.
Sophia (support): Filed follow-up with affected customer contacts and planned communication.
Emily (customer): appreciated the quick response. we'll gate our schema sizes for now.
Ana (oncall): Postmortem owner assigned: Marta (runtime). Action items: RT-8811, INF-7342, CHG-5500 (gateway cap). Postmortem and RCA due within 48h.
Raj (ml): Recommend adding alert specifically for tokenization_time p99 > 1s on json_mode=true requests.
Marta (runtime): Closing active mitigations, keeping monitoring for 1h.
incident-bot: Incident state -> MITIGATED (monitoring). Incident INC-2026-07-15-18 created.
Ana (oncall): Nice job team. Please add notes to the oncall handover doc. I'll add the timeline to the incident tracker.
Sophia (support): I'll circulate the customer summary and link to the postmortem when it's ready. :thumbsup:
